title: 03 Lullwort: organic wellness hero
strengths: Fraunces for the headline and the tin label with Instrument Sans for everything else is a good pair, and the tin's label (No. 3 Dusk Blend, chamomile, valerian) is drawn with real care
Copy sounds like a tea company: 'Chamomile, lemon balm and valerian, blended in small batches for the last hour of your evening'
The paper texture and the pen-and-wash illustration style are consistent across sun, flowers, tin and cup
slop_signals: 'steep' sits in a sage pill highlight inside the headline; the highlighted-word move
Cream ground, a large clay/terracotta sun disc and dark-brown text: the brown + orange + cream palette the house rules flag, with the sage pulling it muddier
Two buttons ('Shop sleep teas' filled terracotta, 'Take the bedtime quiz' outlined) and a three-item dot-separated reassurance row underneath
The illustration is an assembly (sun, moon, three sparkles, daisies, valerian, tin, cup, hill) rather than one subject; the sparkles by the moon are decoration
Left text stack / right illustration is the DTC Shopify hero everyone ships
fixes: Re-cut the palette: cream and ink plus one accent (sage or clay, not both); make the text near-black, not brown
Remove the pill behind 'steep' and let the serif carry it, or set 'steep' in italic
Give the illustration one subject: the tin and cup on the horizon line at the bottom edge, as Yellowbird does, and cut the sun disc, moon and sparkles
One button; move the quiz to a text link
Drop the reassurance row or set it as a single quiet line under the nav

references.what: Flat yellow ground, one serif headline, thick-outline art as the horizon and nothing else; one idea, no buttons competing
Warm palette done with strong tonal contrast (orange on deep brown), a pill nav, tiny corner copy, the product held in hands as the subject
Product photography as the hero with one button; the cream/green world is clean because the jars are the only warm thing
A sleep brand with one photograph, three lines of copy and one button; restraint sells calm

owner.said: Hidden under the owner's rule for pieces below 4 (2026-10-18: hide until better); round 4 stopped at 3.5

changed: Palette re-cut through the engine: deep sage green brand #3D5A47, cool green-grey paper, chamomile yellow for the flowers only, warmth 85 to 30; no brown, orange or cream
Layout: one-line 90 px headline, lede and one button left, a 2 x 2 spec strip right (steep, per cup, tin, caffeine); the botanical plate is a horizon along the bottom

One object: a tea caddy on a shelf in front of the three plants it is made of, each labelled with its share, Latin name and the part used (chamomile 50% flowers, lemon balm 30% leaves, valerian 20% root, shown cut in a dish); the label prints 50 / 30 / 20 as one three-ink bar
Removed the sage pill behind 'steep', the second button, the reassurance row, the sun disc, moon, sparkles, cup, hill and blurred shadow discs
Tin redrawn: opaque slip lid, one light from the left, contact and cast shadows, standing on the shelf

facts: Lullwort shares the 'Lull' stem with Lullwater (app-screens/02), another sleep brand in the showcase

pairwise.result: lost 3, lost 3, then lost 2 on the final tin

pairwise.note: Every judge who preferred Seed gave the same reason: its jars are photographs and this tin is visibly drawn in code. The final tin (round 4 shading fixes) was not re-judged.

changed: Rebuilt: the botanical plate (clip-art daisies, lemon balm, valerian dish), the three callouts, the spec table, the 50/30/20 bar and the plate caption are gone

One object: the tin, straight on and a little above eye level, drawn in SVG with a shallow slip lid, a paper label, physically based matte shading (one light from the upper left, a broad soft sheen instead of the stripe highlights), a rim light, a lid seam, a tight contact shadow and a soft one
Every label line sits on the same ellipse as the label's edges (SVG textPath)
A wall and a table top give the tin somewhere to stand; the copy sits on the wall, vertically centred, so the empty lower left is gone
Headline two lines at the 90 px token; one line of copy; one action, 'Add to bag · £14'
